work.title: String Quartet No. 1 in E minor, “From My Life”

version.value: The complete quartet, four movements on seven sides
version.note: The item lists the movements and parts side by side; the edition used by the players is not identified.

performers.note: The Internet Archive description credits the Curtis String Quartet with these four players and assigns Brodsky to violin I and Jaffe to violin II. The label of side 1 (MM-405 pressing, 70344-D) names Brodsky and Jaffe as violins, Aronoff as viola and Cole as cello, without assigning the violin parts.

date.note: The Internet Archive description gives 6 March 1940. No second source for the date was found.

catalogue.value: M-405 (69849-D to 69852-D); automatic sequence AM-405 (69853-D to 69856-D); later reissue MM-405 (70344-D to 70347-D)
catalogue.note: The label scanned in the item reads MM 405-1, 70344-D, the drop-automatic reissue pressing. The item description says the set was issued in May 1940; Columbia’s October 1940 catalogue lists all three number ranges.

matrixTakeSides.value: Sides 1–7, matrices XCO 27013 to 27019; side 8, XCO 27020, is Tchaikovsky’s scherzo and is not part of this recording
matrixTakeSides.note: Side 1: first movement, part 1; side 2: first movement, part 2; side 3: second movement, part 1; side 4: second movement, part 2 and third movement, part 1; side 5: third movement, part 2; side 6: third movement, part 3 and finale, part 1; side 7: finale, part 2. Take numbers are not given.

credits.note: No personal mastering credit is given.

date.note: The item was added to the Internet Archive on 4 July 2022; the date of the transfer is not stated.

processing.note: Equipment, equalisation and restoration are not stated. The file is a single continuous MP3 of the seven sides.

digital.format: VBR MP3; the uploader’s continuous transfer of seven 78-rpm sides

composition.value: Smetana died on 12 May 1884; the composition is in the public domain.
composition.note: The death date is from the Bedřich Smetana Museum. This does not cover a later edition or arrangement.

recording.value: Territorial EU phonogram public-domain basis: first issued in 1940, before 1963
recording.note: The project’s eu-published-before-1963 rule applies to a Columbia set issued in 1940: the former 50-year phonogram term had expired before the 2011 extension applied on 1 November 2013. The Internet Archive description gives the issue as May 1940. Columbia’s own October 1940 catalogue independently lists the set as M-405 (69849-D to 69852-D), so the first issue was no later than October 1940. This is not US or worldwide clearance and not a Creative Commons licence.

rights.creditLine: Smetana, String Quartet No. 1 in E minor, “From My Life”; Curtis String Quartet. Columbia Masterworks M-405 (1940 issue), Internet Archive transfer. Territorial EU phonogram basis only.
